title: 光学元件的操作、定位与保养
source_doc: course/Photonics & Laser Safety Series/06_6. Optical Handling Positioning and Care.md
author_source: project/Photonics & Laser Safety Series/06_6. Optical Handling Positioning and Care/src.py

points.K2: 光学导轨：一根轨道搭系统
points.K12: 光阑、滤光片架和其他支架
points.K19: 一个坏元件拖累整个系统

shots.scene: 欣欣站在光学平台旁，台上有导轨、镜架和升降台
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an optical table with a rail, lens mounts and a small lab jack, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲光学元件的安装、定位和维护。
overlay: 光学元件的安装、定位与维护

shots.scene: 导轨、平台、镜架、放大镜四个图标排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Four icons in a row: an optical rail, an optical table with a hole grid, a lens mount, and a magnifying glass. No people.
shots.narration: 装得稳、调得准、查得细、护得好。

shots.scene: 阿杰面对一堆镜架、立杆和调整台，不知从何下手
shots.prompt_en: The young male student stands before a pile of lens mounts, posts and small stages on a bench, unsure where to start.
shots.narration: 阿杰要搭光路，零件却认不全。

shots.scene: 他拿起一片镜片对着灯看，发现一道细划痕
shots.prompt_en: He holds a lens up to a lamp and spots a fine scratch on its surface.
shots.narration: 这片镜子有划痕，还能用吗？

shots.scene: 小研把一根导轨放到桌上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sets a long optical rail on the bench and smiles.
shots.narration: 小研说：从导轨和镜架讲起。

shots.scene: 欣欣在空白白板前竖起手指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands in front of a blank whiteboard and raises one finger.
shots.narration: 会装、会调，还要会检查。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着一排镜架和调整台图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a row of icons: lens mounts, a translation stage and a rotation stage.
shots.narration: 先认识各种镜架和调整台。

shots.scene: 导轨和平台上搭好的两套光路
shots.prompt_en: Two neat optical setups, one on a long rail and one on an optical table, lasers enclosed. No people.
shots.narration: 再学在导轨和平台上搭系统。

shots.scene: 放大镜下的镜片，有一道划痕
shots.prompt_en: A lens under a magnifying glass showing a small scratch. No people.
shots.narration: 最后学会检查元件有没有毛病。

shots.section_title: 光学导轨：一根轨道搭系统
shots.scene: 一根长导轨，上面一排滑座和立杆
shots.prompt_en: A long optical rail on a bench with several carriages and posts holding lenses and a screen. No people.
shots.narration: 光学导轨，是一根长而稳的底座。
overlay: 光学导轨：一根轨道搭系统

shots.section_title: 光学导轨：一根轨道搭系统
shots.scene: 立杆上下伸缩，镜片高度随之变化
shots.prompt_en: A post in a carriage sliding up and down, changing the height of a lens holder on top. No people.
shots.narration: 元件装在可调高度的立杆和支架上。

shots.section_title: 光学导轨：一根轨道搭系统
shots.scene: 手松开锁紧旋钮，滑座沿导轨滑动后再拧紧
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand loosens a locking knob, slides a carriage along the rail, then tightens the knob again.
shots.narration: 松开锁紧螺钉滑过去，到位再拧紧。

shots.section_title: 光学导轨：一根轨道搭系统
shots.scene: 导轨上依次排着透镜、反射镜、滤光片、探测器
shots.prompt_en: Along one rail stand a lens, a mirror, a filter and a detector in a row. No people.
shots.narration: 一根导轨，就能串起一整套系统。

shots.scene: 三种导轨截面图标：三角、双矩形、平床
shots.prompt_en: Three cross-section icons side by side: a triangle, two small rectangles, and a wide flat block with a dovetail. No people.
shots.narration: 导轨截面有三种。

shots.scene: 三角导轨，两侧有 V 形槽，滑座卡在上面
shots.prompt_en: A triangular rail with V-shaped grooves on both sides and a carriage clamped onto it. No people.
shots.narration: 三角导轨，可用铝、铸铁或钢做。

shots.scene: 侧面锁紧螺钉顶进 V 形槽的特写
shots.prompt_en: Close-up of side locking screws pressing into the V-grooves of a triangular rail. No people.
shots.narration: 两侧凹槽导向，锁紧螺钉固定。

shots.scene: 两根平行的铝导轨，间距固定
shots.prompt_en: Two parallel aluminum rails with a fixed gap between them, a carriage riding on both. No people.
shots.narration: 双矩形导轨，两根平行，多为铝制。

shots.scene: 一短一长两根导轨并排
shots.prompt_en: A short rail and a much longer rail side by side on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 长度从十几厘米到约两米。

shots.scene: 导轨上的开槽孔用螺栓固定到桌面
shots.prompt_en: Bolts going through slotted holes in a rail into a flat table top. No people.
shots.narration: 开槽孔能把导轨固定在台面上。

shots.scene: 导轨侧面一条刻度尺，滑座指针对准刻度
shots.prompt_en: A rail with a ruler scale along its side and a carriage pointer aligned to a mark. No people.
shots.narration: 侧面带刻度尺，不用再拿尺子量。

shots.scene: 厚重的花岗岩平床导轨，上面有燕尾槽
shots.prompt_en: A heavy granite flat-bed optical bench with a dovetail slot along the top and carriages on it. No people.
shots.narration: 平床导轨用不锈钢或花岗岩做。

shots.scene: 平床导轨像一块磐石，旁边是小导轨在晃
shots.prompt_en: A massive flat-bed bench sitting still like a rock, next to a small light rail shaking with motion lines. No people.
shots.narration: 它又重又稳，用在最要求稳定的地方。

shots.scene: 截面、重量、稳定、价格四个图标围着导轨
shots.prompt_en: Four icons around a rail: a cross-section shape, a weight, a steady level bubble and a coin stack. No people.
shots.narration: 选导轨，看截面、重量、稳定和价格。

shots.scene: 小研对着空白采购单比较两根导轨
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student compares two rail samples with a blank purchase form on a desk.
shots.narration: 要买的人，得把这些都弄清楚。

shots.scene: 一张大光学平台，台面布满整齐的螺纹孔
shots.prompt_en: A large optical table with a grid of evenly spaced threaded holes across the steel top. No people.
shots.narration: 光路要在多个方向排布，就用光学平台。

shots.scene: 镜架直接拧进台面螺纹孔
shots.prompt_en: A gloved hand screwing a post holder directly into a threaded hole on the optical table.
shots.narration: 孔距相等，镜架可直接拧上去。

shots.scene: 台面剖开，里面是蜂窝状结构
shots.prompt_en: A cutaway of the optical table top showing a honeycomb core between steel plates. No people.
shots.narration: 钢台面里面是蜂窝芯，又平又刚。

shots.scene: 有腿和无腿两种平台
shots.prompt_en: Two optical tables: one full table with legs and one tabletop breadboard without legs. No people.
shots.narration: 大小不一，有带腿的，也有不带腿的。

shots.scene: 阿杰从旁边走过，地面振动波纹传向桌腿
shots.prompt_en: The young male student walking past in the background sends ripple lines through the floor toward the legs of an optical table.
shots.narration: 人在旁边走动，地面会传来振动。

shots.scene: 气浮腿像减震器把波纹挡在下面，台面平静
shots.prompt_en: Pneumatic isolation legs drawn like shock absorbers stop the ripples, the table top stays calm. No people.
shots.narration: 气浮隔振腿，像减震器一样挡住它。

shots.scene: 带隔振腿的平台旁价格标签更高
shots.prompt_en: An optical table with isolation legs next to a blank price tag with an up arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 这种平台效果好，价格也更高。

shots.scene: 老周和小研对着平面图讨论平台尺寸
shots.prompt_en: The older man and the female graduate student discuss a blank floor plan with a table outline on it.
shots.narration: 选平台，先想清实验需要什么。

shots.scene: 小台面被人一碰就移位，打叉
shots.prompt_en: A small light table on four thin legs sliding when someone bumps it, shown as an icon crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 台面太小太轻，容易被人碰动。

shots.scene: 搁板、尺寸、孔距图标叠加，价格条上升
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a shelf, a size arrow and a hole grid stacking up while a price bar rises. No people.
shots.narration: 配置越多，价格越高。

shots.scene: 五种透镜支架线描排成一行
shots.prompt_en: Five simple lens holder icons in a row: a sliding clamp, a spring clamp, a swing arm, a threaded ring and a self-centering ring. No people.
shots.narration: 透镜和反射镜，有多种支架来固定。

shots.scene: 弹簧夹轻轻夹住镜片边缘
shots.prompt_en: A spring clamp gently holding a lens by its rim on a post. No people.
shots.narration: 夹住边缘，把元件定在光路上。

shots.scene: 阿杰在老周指导下把透镜装进支架
shots.prompt_en: The young male student mounts a lens into a holder on a post under the guidance of the older man, both wearing gloves.
shots.narration: 实操课上，要亲手装一装。

shots.section_title: 光阑、滤光片架和其他支架
shots.scene: 可变光阑叶片开合，中间孔变大变小
shots.prompt_en: An iris diaphragm on a post with its blades opening and closing so the center hole grows and shrinks. No people.
shots.narration: 可变光阑，开孔大小能调。
overlay: 光阑、滤光片架和其他支架

shots.section_title: 光阑、滤光片架和其他支架
shots.scene: 单片和多片滤光片架、棱镜架、激光器架
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a single filter holder, a multi-filter holder, a prism holder and a laser holder clamp. No people.
shots.narration: 还有滤光片架、棱镜架、激光器架。

shots.scene: 剪式升降台转动旋钮，平台升起
shots.prompt_en: A scissor lab jack with a knob being turned, its top platform rising. No people.
shots.narration: 转动旋钮，剪式升降台就能升降。

shots.scene: 正弦台一端铰链，一端螺杆把板抬起倾斜
shots.prompt_en: A sine table with a hinge at one end and a screw at the other lifting the top plate to a tilt. No people.
shots.narration: 正弦台一头铰链，一头螺杆，能调角度。

shots.scene: 转动千分尺，平移台上层平移
shots.prompt_en: A linear translation stage with a micrometer knob; turning it slides the top plate smoothly. No people.
shots.narration: 拧千分尺，平移台就直线移动。

shots.scene: 两个平移台十字叠放，可前后左右移动
shots.prompt_en: Two translation stages stacked crosswise with arrows showing motion in two directions. No people.
shots.narration: 两个垂直叠放，就能前后左右移。

shots.scene: 平移台和旋转台组合在一起
shots.prompt_en: A translation stage combined with a rotation stage on top, with straight and curved arrows. No people.
shots.narration: 还能和别的台子组合成更多动作。

shots.scene: 旋转台转一整圈的示意
shots.prompt_en: A rotation stage with a circular arrow showing a full turn, driven by a small knob with a worm gear. No people.
shots.narration: 旋转台由蜗杆带动，能转一整圈。

shots.scene: 立杆上的偏振片随旋转台转动
shots.prompt_en: A polarizer disc on a vertical post turning with a rotation mount. No people.
shots.narration: 可以让偏振片等元件转起来。

shots.scene: 反射镜架两颗旋钮，镜面上下左右微微倾斜
shots.prompt_en: A mirror mount with two adjustment knobs, the mirror tilting slightly up-down and left-right. No people.
shots.narration: 倾斜调整架，能朝一个或两个方向偏。

shots.scene: 激光管两端的镜片靠调整架对准
shots.prompt_en: A closed laser tube icon with mirror mounts at both ends being aligned, arrows on the knobs. No people.
shots.narration: 调激光器两端的反射镜，离不开它。

shots.scene: 测角仪托着物体绕上方一点转动
shots.prompt_en: A goniometer stage tilting an object so that it rotates around a point above it, marked with a dot. No people.
shots.narration: 测角仪让物体绕空间一点转动。

shots.scene: 两个测角仪叠放，两个方向绕同一点转
shots.prompt_en: Two goniometers stacked at right angles, curved arrows meeting at one common point. No people.
shots.narration: 两个叠起来，能绕同一点两个方向转。

shots.scene: 镜片放大图上的划痕、麻点、崩边
shots.prompt_en: A magnified lens with a scratch line, small pits and a chipped edge highlighted. No people.
shots.narration: 用久了，元件会出现划痕、麻点、崩边。

shots.scene: 镜片内部一个小气泡，胶合透镜中间有斑
shots.prompt_en: A lens with a tiny bubble inside its glass, next to a cemented double lens with a spot in the glue layer. No people.
shots.narration: 内部会有夹杂，胶合面也会出问题。

shots.scene: 手指捏镜面、镜片磕桌角、加热图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a fingertip touching a lens face, a lens knocking a table edge, and a heat symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 多半是拿放不当，或受力受热造成的。

shots.section_title: 一个坏元件拖累整个系统
shots.scene: 一排光路中一片镜片发暗，后面的光斑都变糊
shots.prompt_en: A row of lenses in a light path where one dark lens makes all the spots after it blurry. No people.
shots.narration: 一个坏元件，就能拖累整个系统。
overlay: 一个坏元件拖累整个系统

shots.section_title: 一个坏元件拖累整个系统
shots.scene: 缺陷处射出一道杂散反射光，打到旁边的电路板
shots.prompt_en: A stray reflected ray coming off a flaw on a lens and hitting a nearby circuit board with a spark icon, inside an enclosure. No people.
shots.narration: 用强激光时，缺陷的反射还会伤设备。

shots.section_title: 一个坏元件拖累整个系统
shots.scene: 小研拿着镜片，在“用”和“不用”两个框之间判断
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student holds a lens by its edges and looks between a green check box and a red X box.
shots.narration: 要会检查，再决定能不能用。

shots.scene: 小研按规程清洁镜片后放上显微镜
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student wearing gloves places a cleaned lens on a microscope stage.
shots.narration: 查表面，先按规定方法清洁。

shots.scene: 灯和聚光镜从侧面照亮镜片
shots.prompt_en: A lamp with a condenser lens lighting the lens on the microscope stage from a low side angle. No people.
shots.narration: 侧面打光，再用显微镜细看。

shots.scene: 镜片中心区域高亮，划痕在中心被打叉
shots.prompt_en: A lens with its central usable area highlighted; a scratch inside the center is marked with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 中心和通光区内，不能有划痕。

shots.scene: 台上激光穿过被测片和负透镜，扩大后投到白屏
shots.prompt_en: On a bench, a small laser sends a beam through a test piece and then a diverging lens, spreading onto a white screen. No people.
shots.narration: 激光穿过被测件，经负透镜投到白屏。

shots.scene: 屏上光斑中一块暗影
shots.prompt_en: A bright round patch on the white screen with one dark shadow spot in it. No people.
shots.narration: 看屏上有没有局部明暗变化。

shots.scene: 移开被测片，屏上光斑均匀
shots.prompt_en: The same setup with the test piece removed and an even bright patch on the screen. No people.
shots.narration: 拿走被测件再看，排除光源本身的问题。

shots.scene: 被测片在架上上下左右移动
shots.prompt_en: The test piece on a small stage moving up, down, left and right across the beam, arrows shown. No people.
shots.narration: 移动被测件，把各个部分都查一遍。

shots.scene: 被测窗口放在标准平面样板上
shots.prompt_en: A test window placed on top of a thick reference flat on a bench. No people.
shots.narration: 平面度，用标准平面样板来比。

shots.scene: 汞灯加绿色滤光片照下，出现明暗相间的条纹
shots.prompt_en: A mercury lamp with a green filter and a beam splitter lights the test piece, and bright and dark stripes appear across it. No people.
shots.narration: 单色光下，两面之间会出现明暗条纹。

shots.scene: 几种条纹图：直条纹、同心圆、弯曲条纹
shots.prompt_en: Four circular icons with fringe patterns: straight lines, concentric rings, curved lines and wavy lines. No people.
shots.narration: 条纹的形状，暴露出面形问题。

shots.scene: 直条纹打勾，同心圆标“凸凹”图标
shots.prompt_en: Straight even fringes with a green check, concentric rings with a dome icon, wavy fringes with a warped plate icon. No people.
shots.narration: 直而匀是平的，弯了圈了就有起伏。

shots.scene: 小研对照条纹图册判读
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student compares fringes on a test piece with a blank reference chart.
shots.narration: 判读条纹，是技术员要练的本事。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现材料、镀膜、滤光片、镜架图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of a glass block, a coated lens, a filter and a lens mount.
shots.narration: 材料、元件、支架，到这里讲完了。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起一盏灯和一只眼睛图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a lamp icon and an eye icon.
shots.narration: 下一课讲光源，还有人眼为何怕光。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现导轨和平台图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside floating icons of an optical rail and an optical table with isolation legs.
shots.narration: 一维用导轨，多维和隔振用平台。

shots.scene: 升降、平移、旋转、倾斜四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a lab jack, a translation stage, a rotation stage and a tilt mount. No people.
shots.narration: 升降、平移、旋转、倾斜，各有调整台。

shots.scene: 显微镜、投影屏、条纹三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a microscope, a white screen with a spot, and a fringe pattern. No people.
shots.narration: 表面、内部、平面度，分别去检查。

shots.scene: 一片有划痕的镜片被放进不合格盒
shots.prompt_en: A scratched lens is placed into a box marked with a red X icon. No people.
shots.narration: 一个坏元件，会拖累整个系统。

shots.scene: 欣欣在整齐的光学平台旁挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye beside a tidy optical table with rails and mounts.
shots.narration: 下一课讲光源和人眼，下次见！
